entries.answer: The United Nations is an international organization founded in 1945 for international cooperation and collective action.
World War II was a global war fought from 1939 to 1945.
World War I was a global conflict fought mainly from 1914 to 1918.
The Roman Empire was a state centered on Rome that developed from the Roman Republic and lasted in the West until the fifth century.
Ancient Egypt was a civilization centered along the Nile with a history spanning several millennia.
The Renaissance was a period of major cultural, artistic and intellectual change in Europe, traditionally associated with the fourteenth through seventeenth centuries.
